concept_name: 강변 인쇄 공방의 첫 도판과 봄바람

reference.scope: Visible face and hair cues only; no inferred name, personality, biography or body measurement.

reference_property_anchor.literal_evidence: using the supplied photograph as the face and short black bob reference

authority_boundary.wardrobe_geometry_and_scene: agent-owned optional realizations; no additional requester locks
authority_boundary.candidate_selection: not_started; no adoption inferred from authored source or this plan
authority_boundary.effective_hard_gate_set: not_yet_derived; must exactly come from the immutable pack plus audited composed selection
authority_boundary.authored_observations: supplemental unless an actual pack contract independently owns the duty

view_and_complexity_plan.staging_origin: already-frozen agent baseline; final choices remain editable within open dimensions
view_and_complexity_plan.framing: Baseline head-to-mid-calf vertical composition includes face, both contacts, torso layers and a useful skirt span. It is authorial rather than a user framing lock.
view_and_complexity_plan.direction: Prefer a near-front shallow three-quarter projection with paper beside the torso, enough shoulder turn to perform the clip action and enough frontal garment area to separate the three layers. Camera direction and height remain open.
view_and_complexity_plan.density: One person, one meaningful hand-held print and one drying line carry the action. A second sheet, window/curtain and workbench traces stay subordinate. No additional prop or garment is owed by a feature count.
view_and_complexity_plan.occlusion_priority: Paper and forearms must not hide the selected knit cells, inner upper edge, hem order or significant contact. Adjust only open staging if the adopted contract requires better visibility.
view_and_complexity_plan.native_readability: Resolve actual yarn paths, textile transmission and contact boundaries at original image resolution; metadata, labels and upscale sharpening cannot replace unresolved pixels.
view_and_complexity_plan.limits: No exact fiber, gauge, GSM, pressure, stretch, dye process, hidden lining absence, concealed underwear absence or biography is pixel-verifiable.

planned_optional_topic_discovery.considered_target: spring_sf057_02 / spf_sf057_02 (new open-stitch variant) only if the actual pack exposes a compatible eligible full contract
planned_optional_topic_discovery.reason: This independently written scene already separates connected yarn gaps from its declared underlying blouse and camisole surfaces. A complete compatible opt-in can make that topic auditable without changing user locks.
planned_optional_topic_discovery.rejection_boundary: Do not substitute an attached neckline mesh-insert contract for the separate blouse/vest relationship or a cardigan contract for a vest merely because they are neighboring labels. Do not invent or force an unexposed ID into the pack.
planned_optional_topic_discovery.other_topic_choices: Decide only after full exposed details; optional lookup and bundle-associated profiles alone create no hard activation.

observations.owner_path: outer vest yarn paths → true gaps → independently declared blouse surface
observations.baseline_evidence: repeated open diamond holes made by visible intersecting yarn loops
observations.view_need: Vest front large enough to resolve connected yarn edges and multiple cell interiors at native resolution.
observations.success: Opaque connected yarn bounds actual open gaps, and a separate surface is visible through them in this one image.
observations.visibility_failure: Unresolved yarn paths or openings hidden behind paper/arms cannot pass.
observations.authority: supplemental_topic_test; selected contract may independently promote its actual gate

observations.topic: Yarn, blouse and camisole are separate owners
observations.owner_path: outer knit vest → sheer blue blouse → opaque sage camisole
observations.baseline_evidence: its yarn remaining opaque while its true gaps reveal the separate fabric beneath
observations.view_need: Near-front view of one uncluttered torso region where yarn edges, blouse fabric and the inner top can be distinguished.
observations.success: The three distinct clothing surfaces show one consistent exterior-to-interior order rather than a flat combined print.
false_substitutes: skin-colored opaque lining scored as skin
observations.visibility_failure: If the lower surface cannot be owned, record unobservable instead of inferring it from the prompt.

observations.topic: One sheer panel crosses the camisole boundary
observations.owner_path: blue blouse upper chest → camisole straight upper edge → same blouse over sage body
observations.baseline_evidence: Above that camisole edge the sheer blouse transmits the skin tone; below it the same sheer fabric transmits the sage surface.
observations.view_need: Camisole edge not hidden by dense vest ribbing, print paper or the hand. Enough chest panel remains visible above and below the edge.
observations.success: A visibly continuous blue textile layer transmits skin above the solid inner-top edge and sage cloth below it; the inner edge has a concrete owner.
false_substitutes: Bare opening mistaken for transparent fabric
color change caused only by shadow
observations.visibility_failure: A concealed inner edge or unresolved blue textile makes this observation fail for visibility.

observations.owner_path: blue sleeve textile → same wearer arm skin; cuff → sleeve
observations.baseline_evidence: the blue translucent sleeves reveal softened skin through their fabric
observations.view_need: One meaningful sleeve region away from the doubled cuff and a wrist boundary with actual cloth visible.
observations.success: Positive blue cloth continuity and softened underlying arm tone remain readable together; cuffs belong to the same sleeves.
false_substitutes: Bare arm colored by blue light
observations.visibility_failure: A sleeve wholly in dark shadow or cropped out is unobservable.

observations.owner_path: vest neckline/hem ribbed bands → same vest openwork body
observations.baseline_evidence: bounded by dense ribbing around the neckline and hem
observations.view_need: Keep the neck and waist trim visible with cloth resolution sufficient to distinguish raised ribs from flat stripes.
observations.success: Dense ribbed bands have actual raised/recessed yarn structure and visibly join the same openwork vest.
false_substitutes: separate scarf mistaken for neckline band
observations.visibility_failure: A band that is visually smooth or fully obscured cannot establish rib topology.

observations.owner_path: outer vest ribbed hem → blouse strip → skirt upper edge
observations.baseline_evidence: A strip of the blouse extends below the vest's ribbed hem and lies over the upper edge of a taupe pleated midi skirt.
observations.view_need: Torso-to-waist area free of paper and workbench occlusion; all three real edges in one image.
observations.success: The three actual garment boundaries preserve the stated overlap order and reveal the intervening blouse strip.
false_substitutes: Three-color print on a single garment
observations.visibility_failure: Any missing boundary makes the complete three-edge relationship unobservable.

observations.topic: Pleats and wrap edge belong to one skirt
observations.owner_path: skirt folded ridges/recesses → same skirt diagonal crossing front edge
observations.baseline_evidence: The skirt's broad folds fall vertically, with a distinct diagonal wrap edge crossing its front.
observations.view_need: View from waist through meaningful lower skirt span, with diagonal edge and several folds resolved.
observations.success: Actual folded fabric creates broad vertical pleats while a distinct front crossing boundary belongs to the same skirt.
false_substitutes: single side slit replacing an overlap
observations.visibility_failure: Do not infer a wrap layer from a diagonal shadow or a pleat label.

observations.owner_path: same woman right thumb/index → spring clip → paper dry upper margin and taut drying line
observations.baseline_evidence: her right thumb and index finger squeeze a small metal spring clip around the print's dry upper margin and the line
observations.view_need: Upper contact beside the torso at shoulder level, both important finger contacts and clip jaws visible at native resolution.
observations.success: The fingers coherently operate the actual clip; its jaws engage the paper margin and line in one load-bearing contact arrangement.
false_substitutes: clip touching paper but missing line
line passing through hand or unrelated clip
observations.visibility_failure: A hidden jaw-to-paper/line relation is a visibility failure, not proof of an impossible mechanism.
observations.authority: anticipated embodiment contact/space and reach evidence; exact gates await the final review

observations.topic: Lower paper support and body chain
observations.owner_path: same woman left thumb/fingertips → dry lower paper corner; shoulders/elbows → both hands
observations.baseline_evidence: her left thumb and fingertips steady its dry lower corner beside her right hip
observations.view_need: Lower support point beside the right hip visible, with enough arm chain to attribute each hand correctly.
observations.success: A distinct left hand holds the dry lower corner while a plausible connected arm chain reaches it; it does not merge into the print or right hand.
false_substitutes: two hands acting on incompatible locations
observations.visibility_failure: Hidden consequential support is unobservable; ordinary foot support may remain outside the mid-calf crop.

observations.owner_path: open window and lifted curtain → curling free paper corner → stabilized held corner and attention toward upper clip
observations.baseline_evidence: The lower corner has stopped fluttering in her hand while the free opposite corner still bends in the breeze.
observations.view_need: Keep a small window/curtain trace and the print silhouette beside the subject; scene traces remain subordinate to clothing and hand contact.
observations.success: The image supports an understandable paper-stabilizing action, with a visible reason to handle the sheet now; the richer backstory remains an authored inference.
false_substitutes: Unrelated props with no causal connection
static fashion pose explained only by text
observations.visibility_failure: A missing story link is supplemental scene weakness rather than an invented profile gate.

observations.topic: Reference-guided face and short black bob
observations.owner_path: attached source photograph → generated subject visible face/hair guidance
observations.baseline_evidence: using the supplied photograph as the face and short black bob reference
observations.view_need: Face turned enough toward camera for visible features and bob outline to be assessable while attention still belongs to the clip.
observations.success: Source-guided facial cues, short black bob and wispy fringe remain recognizable as appearance guidance at the selected portrait distance.
false_substitutes: invented personal identity or age facts
observations.visibility_failure: A profile-hidden face or unresolved hair is not reference fidelity proof.
observations.authority: requester reference-use property anchor; actual image/reference contracts determine the effective gate set

observations.owner_path: subject bearing/expression + practical setting + material hierarchy
observations.baseline_evidence: her understated warmth carrying a subtle attraction through attention and bearing
observations.view_need: Inspect the whole image before consulting control intensity labels, then inspect native textile and contact regions.
observations.success: Describe the actual impression, subject presence and hierarchy first; separately compare with subtle sensual support, ordinary causality and restrained creativity.
false_substitutes: Prompt intensity numbers presented as perceived image strength
schema PASS presented as user preference
observations.visibility_failure: Artistic weakness stays qualitative even when technical gates pass.

future_review_policy.saved_image: One actual returned concrete local image, with path and SHA recorded. All required components must coexist in that same saved image.
future_review_policy.native_tool: built-in image_gen only; one authorized actual invocation for this arm when READY arrives
future_review_policy.source_pin: READY source generation and actual runtime receipt must agree before composition and native invocation. No current source substituted into an old receipt.
future_review_policy.exact_gate_derivation: After final composition and runtime audit use review-shape; copy exactly its applicable hard gates and review scales. This observation plan is not a parallel hard-gate checklist.
future_review_policy.statuses: Hard review wire statuses are pass/fail only. Unobservable, partial or missing required native evidence is fail with a concrete image-grounded reason.
future_review_policy.qualitative_fields: Keep whole-image impression, control calibration, narrative readability and supplemental topic observations separate from hard_gates.
future_review_policy.failure_capture: Use managed native bridge/shared native error capture and preserve actual outcomes. Unknown or preview-only outcomes do not authorize another invocation or CLI fallback.
future_review_policy.independence: Read and write only this arm and permitted shared execution code/source generation; never consume another arm prompt, pack, image or review.
